description: Read numbered lines from one SEC filing or earnings-call transcript. Use line numbers returned by SearchDocument or request a known range. Returns at most 2,000 lines and identifies the next startLine when truncated.

endLine.description: Last line to read (1-based, inclusive). At most 2,000 lines are returned per call; a longer range is truncated with a note on how to continue.

name: ReadDocumentLines
title: Read Filing Lines
